exclusionBasis.rule: Exclude original201 including the10 not inserted, and all current catalog packages.

methodology: New online research used six GitHub GraphQL searches, official-source web searches, live profile reads, live DSH directory history, raw source, npm registry and exact download windows.
Official means project/company maintained, not DeepSeek endorsed. Homepage cross-links and source package provenance are recorded. No nationality inferred.
14-day activity uses DSH-specific directory commits or actual version publications, not whole-repository freshness.
Monorepo stars and multi-host npm downloads are explicitly scoped.
Project logos are downloaded original assets checked through package-display.mjs. No runtime code or tests executed.

Additional pass read full recursive trees of 29 recent/official candidates and official product websites. Logo, product icon and source navigation glyph are separately labelled; general buttons and emoji were not promoted to logos.
